subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should the supported Wear companion product surface include remote agent selection and paired-phone Gateway connect/disconnect controls, with capability-gated availability during staggered Phone/Watch updates?
rationale: The patch is mechanically designed to keep credentials and direct Gateway transport on the phone, but deciding whether these operational controls belong on the Watch is a durable Android product and upgrade-contract choice.

options.title: Accept the expanded companion contract
options.body: Merge with the capability-negotiated controls as the supported Watch experience, retaining the existing limited surface for older paired phones.

options.title: Narrow the Watch surface
options.body: Keep the restored communication UI but remove agent and Gateway operational controls if they should remain phone-only.

recommendation.title: Accept the expanded companion contract
recommendation.body: Merge with the capability-negotiated controls as the supported Watch experience, retaining the existing limited surface for older paired phones.
